words.name: Raise an army
words.blurb: Recruit troops, where you can recruit them, and what upkeep costs.
words.opening: Armies run out, so this lesson refills one. You hold all of The Deep Wilds, and Westermore sits on its border with 1 troop. Mistbury's 12 can march there too: moves chain like attacks.
words.goal: Have 25 troops at Westermore by turn 3.
hints: Recruit costs 2 gold a troop. You hold The Deep Wilds whole, so you can recruit at Westermore itself, not only at Mistbury.
Upkeep: your first 10 territories are free. Past 10, each turn's upkeep climbs faster than your land does.
words.closing: Gold comes in at the end of every turn, and troops cost 2 each wherever you can recruit. Next: making that gold grow.
